items.title: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.title_zh: SpaceX在星舰第15次飞行中成功"夹住"超重型助推器
items.title_en: SpaceX catches Super Heavy booster to close out Starship Flight 15
items.summary: SpaceX's Flight 15 ends with a successful 'catch' of the Starship/Super Heavy booster, a major milestone toward fully reusable orbital launch systems.

items.title: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
items.title_zh: Lovable 应用因 Supabase 行级安全配置薄弱泄露护照信息与逾 20 万条私信
items.title_en: Lovable apps leak passports and 200K messages via weak Supabase RLS
items.summary: A security research post reveals that poorly configured Row-Level Security in Supabase-backed Lovable apps exposed passport details and over 200K private messages, sparking debate about platform defaults and AI-generated app security.

items.title: Tech companies are trying to shift the concept of privacy again
items.title_zh: EFF：科技公司再次重新定义“隐私”，为无处不在的数据采集正名
items.title_en: EFF: Tech Companies Are Redefining Privacy Again to Normalize Data Capture
items.summary: The EFF argues that tech companies are once again redefining 'privacy' to normalize pervasive data capture, illustrated by HN discussion of AI notetakers recording every professional meeting.
